title: Associate Lead Testing
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
   

  

 If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
   

  

**QA Architect / Lead**
**Exp Range :** 
 8 \- 13 Years
   

  

**Job location :** 
 Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
   

  

 The QA Architect/Lead is responsible for the testing strategy and infrastructure across the entire platform. You will define the four\-tier test framework (unit, integration, contract, acceptance), establish the conventions that ensure every spec\-defined acceptance criterion has a verifying test, build out the validation infrastructure for parallel\-run cutover from the existing Health Data Engine, and lead the load testing campaign that validates the platform's high\-volume
   

  

 capacity claims.
   

  

 This role is technical\-lead calibre. You will design test frameworks that data engineers consume, set the CI/CD gating policies that determine what merges and what doesn't, and lead the validation that determines when the platform is ready for production traffic. You will work in close partnership with the architect on spec\-derived test conventions and with the data engineering team on the operational maturity of every component.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the four\-tier test framework: unit (per spec acceptance criterion), integration (within\-layer composition), contract (cross\-layer schema and behaviour), and acceptance (end\-to\-end scenarios). Establish the conventions that distinguish them and the CI gates that enforce them
* Establish the spec\-to\-test traceability standard. Every acceptance criterion in a unit spec must have at least one named test that verifies it; test names reference the AC ID by convention; CI enforces coverage. The traceability is regulatory\-defensible by design
* Build and maintain the test infrastructure — fixture management (HL7v2, CCDA, CSV, FHIR samples organized by source and DLQ scenario), DBT test runners, FHIR validator integration, Mini Cluster Flink test harnesses, HAPI test server harnesses for FHIR\-Repository interceptor work, end\-to\-end test orchestration
* Establish synthetic test data conventions — no real PHI in fixtures; structured\-but\-synthetic patient names, identifiers, dates; reusable patterns for multi\-source linkage scenarios; coverage of edge cases (NULLs, ECI merges, late\-arriving data, validation failures)
* Lead the load testing campaign — design the eight to ten scenarios that validate sustained 50K msg/sec ingest, 150K msg/sec peaks, full DBT refresh at billion\-row scale, 1,000 concurrent Starburst queries, 5,000 req/sec FHIR API, MDM degradation behaviour, and reprocessing during steady state. Lead execution; report against acceptance criteria
* Lead the parallel\-run validation framework — for the 30\-60 day cutover period when the new platform ingests alongside the existing Health Data Engine, establish what data is compared between the two systems, what tolerances are accepted, what reconciliation reports are produced, and what triggers a rollback decision
* Define performance SLOs and monitoring strategy. Every component has measurable latency, throughput, and freshness budgets. Build dashboards that operators use during incidents and that establish trend baselines over time
* Define and enforce CI/CD test gates — what blocks PR merge (spec lint, AC coverage, unit tests, integration tests, lint/format), what runs nightly (full integration suite, contract tests, slow scenarios), what runs in stage before promotion (acceptance tests). Codify in pipeline configuration and runbooks
* Build out test automation for FHIR profile validation — every Bundle published is validated against US Core 6\.1 in CI and in the runtime path. Establish the FHIR validator deployment, the profile pack management, and the test patterns that prove conformance
* Lead testing for the bidirectional FHIR flow — verifying loop prevention via origin tagging works under load, that the FHIR\-Repository egress interceptor captures every client\-originated change, that the loopback Flink job applies write\-authority rules correctly, and that no echoes propagate
* Establish testing patterns for MDM integration — synthesizing match/no\-match/multi\-match scenarios, validating ECI assignment correctness, validating ECI\_MERGE and ECI\_SPLIT handling end\-to\-end, validating DLQ routing for MDM failures
* Lead validation of data quality at every layer — DBT test suites for CDM, freshness checks at every layer boundary, anomaly detection for ingestion patterns, governance integration for quality metric publication to Atlan
* Mentor data engineers on test authorship under the spec\-driven development framework. Tests are part of every PR; their quality is part of the PR review; the QA lead sets the bar
* Participate in incident response and root cause analysis. Drive test additions that prevent recurrence — every production incident becomes a new acceptance criterion in the affected spec and a new test in the suite


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* 8\+ years of QA experience with at least 3\-5 years focused on data quality, data warehousing, or data platform testing, and 2\+ years in a lead or architect role
* Demonstrated experience defining and operating QA strategies for large\-scale data platforms in cloud environments — preferably GCP
* Strong Python and SQL skills for test framework authorship. Familiarity with pytest and dbt\-test conventions required
* Experience with data validation across batch, streaming (Kafka), and event\-driven pipelines
* Experience with dbt — specifically dbt's native testing framework, dbt\-expectations or dbt\-utils packages, custom test authorship via macros, and source freshness checks
* Experience testing Iceberg or other open\-table\-format\-backed warehouses — schema evolution edge cases, partition handling, snapshot semantics, and CoW vs MoR behavioral differences
* Experience with healthcare data quality testing — HL7v2 parsing edge cases, FHIR profile conformance validation, terminology binding validation, master data quality
* Experience designing and executing load tests for data platforms at scale — JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or custom load generators. Familiarity with realistic load profile design (not just throughput, but representative mix of operations)
* Experience with parallel\-run validation and reconciliation between legacy and replacement data systems
* Strong CI/CD experience — GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Cloud Build. Ability to design pipeline gates and integrate test execution into PR and release workflows
* Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. The role works across engineering, architecture, governance, and customer stakeholder groups


 Nice\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Experience with the HL7 FHIR validator, Inferno, or HAPI FHIR validation tooling
* Atlan experience for data quality metric publication and governance integration
* Experience with chaos engineering or resilience testing for streaming data systems
* Experience integrating spec\-driven or contract\-first frameworks with QA workflows
* Test management tools experience (TestRail, Zephyr, qTest)
* Experience working in HIPAA\-regulated environments — synthetic PHI generation, audit trail validation, regulatory test evidence
* QA or cloud platform certifications


*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us* 
*!*

By combining cloud\-native architecture, intelligent automation, and AI\-powered insights, we're helping global consumer goods, life sciences, and manufacturing companies innovate faster, improve compliance, reduce waste, and bring products to market with greater speed and confidence.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an SDET on the Cloud Platform team, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of the foundational services that power Esko's cloud products.
   

  

 You will work closely with software engineers, architects, and DevOps engineers to build automated testing for platform capabilities such as data and repository services, workflow, search, identity and access management services.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys writing code, understanding how distributed systems behave, finding difficult failure scenarios, and building automation that helps engineering teams release with confidence.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design, develop, and maintain automated tests and test frameworks for cloud platform services and APIs.
* Build API, integration, contract, regression, system, and end\-to\-end tests for distributed services.
* Test complex platform behaviors including data integrity, asynchronous workflows, service interactions, authentication and authorization, and failure scenarios.
* Build performance, scalability, and reliability tests for critical platform services.
* Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines to provide fast feedback to engineering teams.
* Develop test infrastructure, test data, mocks, and tooling needed to test complex cloud services.
* Investigate failures across distributed systems using logs, metrics, traces, and other diagnostic information.
* Partner with software engineers and architects to improve testability and build quality into the software development lifecycle.
* Contribute to automation standards, testing practices, and continuous improvement across the Cloud Platform team.


**Required Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in SDET, Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, or Test Automation roles.
* Strong programming skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another modern programming language.
* Hands\-on experience building automated tests for REST APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native applications.
* Experience with API, integration, regression, and system\-level testing.
* Good understanding of distributed systems and common testing challenges such as asynchronous processing, retries, failures, and service dependencies.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively with software engineers, architects, product managers, and DevOps engineers.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience with AWS or another major cloud platform.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized applications.
* Experience with performance and load testing using JMeter, Gatling or equivalent.
* Experience with API contract testing and testing event\-driven or asynchronous systems.
* Experience debugging distributed systems using observability tools, logs, metrics, and traces.
* Experience with Playwright, Selenium, or other UI automation frameworks.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Within your first year, you will:
   

  

* Establish performance testing and baseline metrics for critical platform services to identify performance regressions early.
* Increase automated coverage of API, integration, reliability, and performance scenarios.
* Identify defects and failure scenarios earlier in the development lifecycle.
* Improve CI/CD quality gates and reduce dependence on manual regression testing.
* Become a trusted engineering partner who helps teams design more testable, reliable, and scalable platform services.

title: HRIS Senior Associate -  Data, Reporting & Testing
description:
**Summary:** 




 The Indus HRIS Senior Associate – Techno\-Functional Data, Reporting \& Testing plays a critical role in enabling scalable, compliant, and audit\-ready HR data operations within Oracle HCM as the organization expands across countries, legal entities, and integrated systems. This role combines
 



 functional HR process understanding with technical HRIS execution, owning expanded responsibilities across HR reporting rationalization, country\-specific regulatory and audit reporting (including ISQM\-equivalent requirements), and complex testing efforts supporting entity onboarding and integrations.
 



 The Senior Associate operates with a high degree of independence may serve as a bridge between HR, Compliance, and IT by translating business and regulatory requirements into technical reporting logic, data validations, and testing outcomes.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Techno\-Functional Reporting \& Data Ownership** 



* Own and enhance HR reporting solutions within Oracle HCM (OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts), translating functional HR and regulatory requirements into technical report logic.
* Collaboration on the rationalization, standardization, and streamlining of existing HR reports by assessing business usage, aligning data definitions, and eliminating duplication across countries and entities.
* Design and support country\-specific regulatory, compliance, and audit reporting, including requirements aligned to ISQM\-equivalent control frameworks.
* Perform advanced data analysis and reconciliation, validating report outputs against Oracle HCM source data and downstream integrations.
* Define and maintain functional and technical documentation, including data definitions, report logic, transformation rules, and checkpoints.



**Testing \& Integration Validation** 




 Participate and/or lead end\-to\-end testing efforts for new country/entity onboarding, configuration changes, and HR system integrations.
 



 Develop and execute detailed test scenarios and scripts that reflect real HR business processes (hire, transfer, termination, organizational changes) and country\-specific variations.
 



 Validate integrations through source\-to\-target testing, ensuring accuracy of employee, assignment, organizational, and regulatory data.
 



 Own defect triage, root cause analysis, and retesting, partnering with HRIS, IT, and vendors through resolution.
 



 Coordinate and execute regression testing for reporting, extracts, and integrations following releases or configuration changes.
 



**Controls, Audit \& Risk Management** 



* Support HRIS control frameworks by ensuring reporting and testing processes meet documented control standards and audit expectations.
* Prepare and maintain audit\-ready evidence, including reconciliations, test results, report logic, and approvals.
* Proactively identify data and control risks introduced by new countries, entities, or integrations and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR systems, reporting accuracy, and data controls.



**Stakeholder Partnership \& Functional Leadership** 



* Act as a techno\-functional SME for HR reporting and testing within the HRIS team.
* Collaborate with IT and integration teams to align functional requirements with technical solutions (APIs, extracts, downstream feeds).
* Mentor Associate\-level team members and contribute to continuous improvement of HRIS reporting and testing standards.



  





**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications:** 



* 4–7\+ years of experience in HRIS, HR technology, or HR data roles with both functional and technical responsibilities.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle HCM data structures and reporting tools.
* Demonstrated experience owning testing activities for HR processes, integrations, or multi\-entity implementations.
* Ability to translate business, regulatory, and audit requirements into technical reporting and testing solutions.
* Proven experience working in audit\-sensitive, controlled environments.
* Experience supporting multi\-country HR implementations and local regulatory reporting.
* Strong documentation, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Demonstrates the ability to effectively prioritize competing priorities and pivot focus as business needs evolve, particularly in response to regulatory deadlines, country/entity expansion, and integration\-driven dependencies.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Advanced experience with OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL.
* Exposure to system integrations (payroll, benefits, IAM, finance, data warehouse/ODS).
* Familiarity with ISQM or equivalent quality, audit, or control frameworks.
* Basic SQL or data querying skills for validation and analysis

title: Hardware Technician
description:
About Bytebeam
 
 Bytebeam builds the hardware and software stacks that power the next generation of smart connected vehicles. From device telemetry and remote diagnostics to OTA updates, alerts, and fleet\-scale device management, Bytebeam helps teams ship connected products faster and operate them reliably in the field.
 



 A lot of what makes hardware actually work happens at the bench and on the line: a clean rework, a shorted net found with a meter, an end\-of\-line jig that catches a bad unit before it ships. The Hardware Technician is the person who makes that happen, both in our lab and at the places our products get built and deployed.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are hiring a Hardware Technician to support our automotive telematics devices across prototyping, bring\-up, production, and field integration. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is excellent with a soldering iron, comfortable with test instruments, can read schematics and board files, and can debug failures down to the component.
 



 You will not be stuck at one bench. You should be ready to travel frequently to our EMS / manufacturing partners, test locations, and customer sites to support builds, set up end\-of\-line test, and help integrate our devices into vehicles and systems.
 


 What You'll DoSoldering and Rework
 * Perform hand soldering and SMD/through\-hole rework on PCBs, including fine\-pitch components, connectors, and wires, to a clean, reliable standard.
* Build, modify, and repair prototype and production boards, including blue\-wire mods and component swaps during debug.


 Component\-Level Debugging
 * Debug board and device failures down to the component level, and help find root cause.
* Use schematics and Gerber / PCB layout files to trace nets, locate components, and probe the right test points.
* Isolate faults across power, analog, digital, and communication sections with guidance from the engineers, and document findings clearly.


 Test and Measurement
 * Use multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and bench test setups / jigs to measure, verify, and characterize device behavior.
* Set up and run test fixtures, and capture and log measurements for the team.


 End\-of\-Line Assembly and Test
 * Support end\-of\-line (EOL) assembly and test for telematics devices: assemble units, run EOL test sequences, and flag and segregate failures.
* Help build, set up, and improve EOL and functional test jigs, and keep them running on the line.


 Field and Integration Support (Travel)
 * Travel frequently to plants, test locations, and customer sites to support production builds, validation, and device integration.
* Set up test benches on site, support installation and integration of devices into vehicles/systems, and help debug issues found in the field.
* Be a reliable pair of hands and eyes for the engineering team wherever the hardware is.


 General
 * Maintain tools, instruments, ESD\-safe practices, and a clean, organized work area.
* Keep clear records of rework, test results, failures, and field observations.


 Must\-Have Skills
 * ITI / Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, or related (or equivalent hands\-on experience)
* 2\+ years hands\-on as an electronics/hardware technician (production, test, lab, or field)
* Strong hand soldering and SMD/through\-hole rework skills, including fine\-pitch work
* Ability to debug component\-level failures and trace faults on a board
* Ability to read schematics and Gerber / PCB layout files
* Hands\-on with multimeters, oscilloscopes, and bench test setups / jigs
* Familiarity with end\-of\-line (EOL) assembly and functional test
* Willing and available to travel frequently to plants, test, and customer locations
* Careful, methodical, ESD\-aware, and good at documenting what was done and observed


 Good\-to\-Have (Strong Plus)
 * Experience with automotive or telematics hardware (cellular/GNSS/CAN/OBD devices)
* Experience setting up or maintaining EOL / functional test jigs and fixtures
* Exposure to flashing/programming devices and basic firmware\-level checks
* Experience with field installation or integration of electronic devices in vehicles
* Familiarity with reading test logs, basic scripting, or test\-equipment automation
* IPC\-A\-610 / IPC J\-STD soldering awareness


 Who We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for a genuinely skilled pair of hands \- someone who takes pride in a clean rework, enjoys hunting down a stubborn fault with a scope and a schematic, and is happy to get on a flight or a train to a plant or a customer site to make a build succeed. You should be dependable, safety\- and quality\-conscious, and the kind of technician engineers trust to do it right and tell them honestly what they found.
 


 Application Note
 * Tell us about the trickiest board\-level fault you have personally found and fixed \- what the symptom was, how you traced it (instruments, schematic/Gerber), what the root cause turned out to be, and how you reworked it.

title: Head of Quality Assurance - Instawork Robotics Labs
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
 Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000\-year data gap” \- the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments \- kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes \- to capture the high\-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Experience:** 
 10\+ years
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Automotive / Mobility / Robotics / Manufacturing
   

  

**About The Role**
 Instawork Robotics creates the highest\-quality, highest\-diversity datasets for robotics and physical AI. We work with many of the most important robotics builders and research labs to solve the most important challenge in robotics \- closing the data gap.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Head of QA** 
 with 10\+ years of experience in automotive, manufacturing, mobility, robotics, or a closely related industry. This person will own the end\-to\-end quality and data\-labeling function across
 **Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Visual Inspection, and process quality** 
 .
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who can build quality systems from the ground up, establish rigorous processes, lead teams, and drive a strong quality culture across operations and engineering.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the QA/QC function: Build and lead the overall quality strategy, processes, standards, and KPIs across operations and manufacturing.
* Visual \& Product Quality: Establish robust visual inspection and defect detection processes, including inspection standards, sampling methodologies, defect classification, and root\-cause analysis.
* Quality Systems: Design and implement SOPs, inspection protocols, quality gates, audit mechanisms, CAPA, and continuous improvement processes.
* Team Leadership: Build, manage, and develop high\-performing QA/QC teams across locations and functions.
* Cross\-functional Quality: Partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Product teams to identify and eliminate recurring quality issues.
* Data \& Metrics: Build quality dashboards and drive metrics such as defect rates, first\-pass yield, rework, rejection rates, customer complaints, and quality escapes.
* Supplier \& Process Quality: Drive supplier quality, incoming inspection, in\-process quality, and final inspection standards.
* Root Cause \& Continuous Improvement: Lead RCA, corrective/preventive actions, and quality improvement initiatives using structured methodologies such as 8D, FMEA, SPC, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.


**What We're Looking For**
* 10\+ years of experience in QA/QC, preferably in the automotive, manufacturing, robotics, mobility, electronics, or hardware industry.
* Strong experience setting up and scaling multi\-layer quality functions and processes from the ground up.
* Experience leading QA and data\-labeling operations for Petabyte\-scale pipelines of real\-world data

As our AI agents make autonomous decisions (payroll calculations, employee workflows, HR automation), testing their correctness, safety, and edge\-case behavior is critical and we need someone excited by that challenge.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Quality Ownership Mindset:
   

  

* You believe quality starts before a line of code is written not something tested for in the final phase
* You work to prevent defects, not just find them reviewing requirements and designs for testability before development begins
* You own quality culture on your team, not just test execution
* You are well versed with new age AI technologies for AI engineering and have show interest working in Agentic build environments.
* You are interested in vibe coding, AI and running QA As a service.


**Advocacy \& Risk Communication**
* You are a quality advocate you raise concerns about risks early, suggest design changes that enhance testability, and don’t stay silent when something feels off
* You communicate quality issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, with data and impact, not just bug counts
* You have the confidence to push back on shipping when quality isn’t there, while being pragmatic about deadlines


**Collaboration \& Partner, Not Gatekeeper**
* You are embedded in the development team participating in sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives with valuable insights, not just status updates
* You collaborate with developers during design and implementation, not just after code is written
* You bring both the developer and user perspective to conversations part detective, part engineer, part customer advocate


**Critical Thinking \& Analytical Skills**
* You have a curious, analytical mindset investigating issues to their root cause, not just logging symptoms
* You think in edge cases identifying the scenarios that others miss and prioritizing testing based on risk and impact
* You can compromise between perfect coverage and good\-enough results while staying flexible under pressure


**Proactive Behaviour \& Gap Identification**
* You provide input on potential quality issues during the design phase before coding starts
* You continuously learn about new testing approaches, tools, and methodologies without waiting to be trained
* You identify flaws in processes and drive improvements, not just report them


**Documentation \& Communication Discipline**
* You write clear, actionable bug reports with precise reproduction steps not vague descriptions
* You create test documentation that is understandable and maintainable by others on the team
* You articulate technical issues in a way that helps developers fix problems faster


**Product Curiosity \& User Empathy**
* You think like a user understanding workflows, personas, and real world usage patterns to design meaningful test scenarios
* You are genuinely curious about the product, not just the test framework you want to understand what users care about and test accordingly
* You are excited by the challenge of testing AI agents that make autonomous decisions payroll, HR workflows, compliance where correctness isn’t optional


 Must have skills
   

  

* Strong hands\-on experience with Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, and TestNG/JUnit is essential because this role expects end\-to\-end automation ownership.
* Solid knowledge of REST Assured, Postman, and API validation is a must, since the platform is built on microservices and AI\-integrated services.
* Experience with Apache JMeter and understanding response times, throughput, SLA validation, and bottleneck analysis is very important.
* Good coding ability in Java is critical, with added value from Python and TypeScript/JavaScript for automation and test utilities.
* Since this is an AI\-native platform, understanding LLMs, AI agents, non\-deterministic outputs, guardrail testing, hallucination detection, and AI API testing is one of the biggest differentiators.
* Knowledge of Git, microservices, REST/Kafka communication, and SQL basics is necessary to test reliably in a real engineering environment.


 Good to have skills
   

  

* Knowledge of Jenkins and GitLab CI/CD is very valuable because QA automation is much stronger when it is fully tied into build and deployment pipelines.
* Being able to run tests in containers and set up stable test environments is a big plus, especially in modern microservices\-based products.
* Since the platform uses event\-driven workflows, understanding how to test Kafka message production and consumption is highly useful.
* Experience with Cucumber/Gherkin or Robot Framework helps in writing clear, behavior\-driven scenarios that improve collaboration between QA, developers, and product teams.
* Familiarity with Axe\-core/WCAG validation and OWASP ZAP adds strong value because it improves both usability and product safety.
* Experience with tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Cody is a strong advantage for speeding up test automation and working efficiently in an AI\-heavy engineering setup.
* Modern code\-first performance testing tools are highly valuable because they fit well into CI/CD workflows and are more flexible for engineering teams than traditional load\-testing setups.
* This is especially important in microservices\-based systems because it helps validate API boundaries and prevents service\-to\-service integration issues early.
* A very strong plus because it enables isolated, Docker\-backed test environments, making integration testing more reliable and production\-like.
* A useful frontend\-focused E2E testing tool with a strong developer experience, especially valuable for faster debugging and tighter collaboration with frontend teams.
* These are great to have because shift\-left security scanning improves product quality early in the pipeline and reduces risk before release.
* This stands out because observability\-driven testing is becoming very important in modern distributed systems, especially for tracing failures across services.

**Description**

 Our Engineering and Product Development team at Industrial Scientific is inviting applications for a Senior Electro\-Mechanical Engineer/Technician to assist in the design and development of next generation industrial safety products and solutions. Industrial Scientific is an industry leader in this space with a range of award\-winning Internet of Things / Connected products and recurring revenue business models. For example, our iNet Now Live Monitoring software and Radius BZ1 Area Monitor recently won platinum awards in the Occupational Health and Safety Industrial Hygiene Awards. As we innovate the future in this space, we will emphasize end\-to\-end solutions that drive experience, connectivity, and data analytics. It all starts with our hardware products that are certified for rugged environments, easy to use and loved by the users whose lives they protect and connected by default. These hardware products have generated almost 100M lifesaving alerts to protect industrial workers in dangerous situations.
   

  

 The Senior Electro\-Mechanical Engineer/Technician is a skilled engineering engineer/technician professional who assists the engineering team with the design of large\-scale mechanical engineering projects. This person acts as a hands\-on technician working to ensure one or several engineering projects are completed successfully in a required time frame while maintaining the highest quality standards.
   

  

 As a Senior Engineer/Technician you would be held to high standards of performance in all areas, both technical and professional, serve as a role model to other technicians and fostering collaboration throughout the entire company. You would be joining a team and organization that embraces open collaboration and teamwork, undertakes agile development, supports an inclusive and diverse workplace, provides opportunities and learning and growth – all while enjoying the mission focused work on eliminating death on the job by 2050\.

 This position is responsible for testing components and designs throughout the Product Development life cycle. This position is expected to work closely with various groups to fully assure a properly designed product from concept to production.

* Conducting sub\-system tests and completing appropriate technical reports.
* Collaborates on test plans, understands requirements, and leads review of test outcomes. Able to execute problem\-solving strategies when a test is not working within parameters.

* Participates in design reviews.

* Participates in testing teams on project activities.
* Participating on cross\-functional product development teams.
* Maintaining a clean and orderly lab environment.

* Developed mechanical assembly and electronics skills.
* Developed soldering skills.

* Able to use Oracle/iProcurement/Mobus/Windchill/JIRA/JAMA.
* Able to commit to and work under deadlines.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Strict adherence to detail.

description:

**Senior Software Development Engineer**

**Preferred Qualification: BE / BTech / ME / MTech**

description:
**About McKesson Compile**
 Established in 1833, McKesson is a US Fortune 10 global leader in healthcare supply chain management solutions, retail pharmacy, healthcare technology, community oncology, and specialty care. We partner with life sciences companies, manufacturers, providers, pharmacies, governments, and other healthcare organizations to help provide the right medicines, medical products, and healthcare services to the right patients at the right time, safely and cost effectively.
   

  

 Based in Bangalore India, McKesson Compile’s data is a comprehensive, full linked system of record for the US Healthcare market, with intelligence on 2M\+ healthcare professionals (HCPs) and over 800K facilities. Compile’s data includes high capture medical and pharmacy claims, closed capture Medicare claims (100%), along with best\-in\-class provider affiliations and customer master.
   

  

 At McKesson we deliver careers with purpose and potential. Our focus on better health starts with creating an inclusive environment with strong values where you can build a fulfilling career. You can count on us to provide you with resources and opportunities to grow and be your best, while contributing to our pursuit of improving lives.
   

  

 The Sr. Associate QA Automation Engineer is responsible for developing and executing manual and automated testing activities across Ontada's product ecosystem, including AI\-enabled and GenAI\-powered solutions. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and QA leads, the engineer will contribute to validating web applications, APIs, backend services, data workflows, and AI\-driven features to ensure high levels of product quality, reliability, and performance.
   

  

 This role partners closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and Operations teams to support the delivery of secure, scalable, and customer\-focused healthcare technology solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Quality Engineering Ownership \& Execution
   

  

* Execute test plans and test cases for assigned features and product modules.
* Participate in requirement reviews and contribute to test scenario identification.
* Identify and document defects with clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing.
* Support release validation activities across multiple environments.


**Test Automation \& Framework Development**
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for UI, API, and service\-layer testing.
* Contribute to existing automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, TOSCA, or equivalent technologies.
* Develop and execute API automation tests using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or similar frameworks.
* Support integration of automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Utilize AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or similar tools to improve productivity and test coverage.


**AI / GenAI Quality Engineering**
* Assist in validating AI\-enabled and GenAI\-powered product features.
* Participate in testing prompt\-based workflows and AI\-generated responses.
* Support validation activities focused on response accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
* Execute predefined test scenarios covering prompt variations and edge cases.
* Develop familiarity with concepts such as LLMs, prompts, RAG, AI agents, and guardrails.
* Utilize AI\-powered tools to assist with test scenario generation and exploratory testing.


**Backend \& Data Testing**
* Perform backend testing using SQL and/or NoSQL data systems.
* Validate data ingestion, transformations, persistence, and integrity across services and environments.
* Assist with testing asynchronous workflows and integrations (e.g., message queues, APIs, batch processes).


**Agile Collaboration**
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners throughout the development lifecycle.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support shift\-left testing practices by engaging early in feature development.


**Quality Governance, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Contribute audit‑ready documentation, including test plans, execution evidence, and reports.
* Participate in root‑cause discussions for quality issues and contribute to corrective actions.
* Identify opportunities for improving QA processes, tools, and documentation; contribute suggestions through established continuous improvement channels.
* Research and evaluate new QA, automation, or performance testing, AI assisted tools and techniques as appropriate.


**Minimum Requirement**
 Degree or equivalent and typically requires 2\+ years of relevant experience.
   

  

**Education**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
   

  

**Critical Skills**
* 2\+ years of Software Quality Assurance experience.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on test automation experience.
* Experience with at least one automation framework such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or TOSCA.
* Experience with API testing using Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent tools.
* Proficiency in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with SQL for backend validation and data testing.
* Familiarity with Git\-based source control systems.


**Additional Skills:**
* Exposure to AI/GenAI testing concepts.
* Experience testing LLM\-powered or AI\-enabled applications.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and prompt validation.
* Familiarity with RAG architectures and AI evaluation techniques.
* Knowledge of healthcare technology or regulated environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.


 Working Conditions
   

  

* Full\-time in office role based in Bangalore, India (IST).
* Collaboration with distributed, cross‑functional teams.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**QA ENGINEER**
**Overview**
 Tintri, a DDN company, builds enterprise storage platforms that power mission\-critical virtualized environments. Our QA Engineering team is the last line of defense before every VMstore release reaches a customer, validating everything from core storage protocols and hardware resiliency to hypervisor integrations and data\-at\-rest encryption. We're looking for a QA Engineer who's equally comfortable writing automation code and getting hands\-on with real storage hardware, someone who enjoys tracing a defect back to its root cause as much as designing the test that caught it in the first place.
   

  

 You'll work closely with development throughout the release cycle, not just at the end of it, helping define what "tested" actually means for a given feature before it's built, then proving it once it is. This is a role for someone who wants deep, hands\-on exposure to enterprise storage internals (NVMe, RAID, encryption, hypervisor ecosystems) while building the automation that lets the whole team move faster and with more confidence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, automate and execute test plans and test cases for the storage platforms.
* Build and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts.
* Clear understanding of defect life cycle.
* Collaborate with developers to understand requirements and define the test strategies.
* Perform root cause analysis of defects and drive issues to resolution.
* Conduct sanity, smoke, performance and stress test coverage.
* Document test execution processes and results.


**Required Qualifications**
* Strong programming ability with hands\-on experience in one or more scripting languages (preferably Python).
* Good understanding of NVMe, SAS, and SATA concepts.
* Hands\-on experience in Linux troubleshooting \& debugging.
* Experience with any one of the hypervisors.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Understanding of NAS \& SMB protocols.
* Storage platform components understanding, including SSD, DIMM, RAID, IPMI, and BMC.
* Storage encryption concepts.


**Education \& Experience**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

title: QA Associate Analyst, E2E [T500-29425]
description:
**About A\&F Co:** 




 At ANSR, we operate A\&F Co. Bengaluru, a hub of digital transformation delivering services exclusively to our client, Abercrombie \& Fitch Co. (A\&F Co.). A\&F Co. is a global, digitally led omnichannel specialty retailer of apparel and accessories catering to kids through millennials with assortments curated for their specific lifestyle needs.
 



 Now is your opportunity to join us and develop dynamic tech solutions to meet the needs of A\&F Co.’s rapidly growing global business. For over 20 years now, companies cutting across size, industry and markets have relied on our expertise to successfully build global business and technology teams. We can help you land a rewarding career in this dynamic industry.
 



 Here, you’ll be part of a team working on Digital Engineering \& Architecture, Data \& Analytics and Digital Operations to build inclusive experiences and outstanding products. Ready to usher in a digital revolution? Apply today.
 



 Disclaimer: Candidates will initially be employed under ANSR and subsequently transitioned to A\&F Co. Bengaluru.
 



  





**QA Associate Analyst –Enterprise Systems** 




**About the Role:** 




**We are looking for a QA Associate Analyst to support quality validation across our enterprise and ERP platforms, including Merchandising, Planning, Product Creation, Inventory, and** 




 related integrations.
 



**This is an early\-career, hands\-on role focused on building strong testing fundamentals,** 
 understanding enterprise business workflows, and learning how large\-scale systems interact. You will execute test cases, validate data and workflows, log defects, and support regression and end\-to\-end testing—while learning automation and modern quality practices under guidance.
 



**This role is ideal for individuals starting their career in Quality Engineering who want to grow into more technical, automation\-focused QE roles over time.** 




  





**What You’ll Do:** 




**Execute Hands\-On Testing for Enterprise Systems:** 



* Execute manual and exploratory test cases for enterprise applications and workflows.
* Validate features against acceptance criteria, business rules, and documented requirements.
* Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality remains stable as changes are introduced.
* Support end\-to\-end testing across systems that exchange data or depend on shared configurations.



  





**Support Data \& Integration Validation:** 



* Validate data accuracy across screens, reports, interfaces, and downstream systems.
* Assist in testing batch jobs, scheduled processes, and integration hand\-offs.
* Compare expected vs. actual results for calculations, rules, and configuration\-driven behavior.
* Help identify data mismatches, missing records, or processing errors.



  





**Participate as Part of an Agile Team:** 



* Participate in sprint ceremonies such as stand\-ups, refinement, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product partners to clarify requirements.
* Ask questions early to ensure test scenarios are well understood before execution.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, and defects clearly.



  





**Support Automation \& Modern Quality Practices (Under Guidance):** 



* Execute existing automated tests and report failures or flakiness.
* Assist senior QEs and developers with test data setup for automation.
* Learn API testing, basic scripting, and automation frameworks used by the team.
* Contribute to improving regression coverage over time.



  





**Defect Tracking \& Continuous Learning:** 



* Log clear, actionable defects with reproduction steps and evidence.
* Re\-test fixes and validate resolutions.
* Review production issues to understand root causes and prevention opportunities.
* Build domain knowledge of enterprise systems and business processes continuously.



  





**What You Bring:** 




**Required Qualifications:** 



* 2–3 years of experience in software testing, QA, or a related role.
* Understanding of basic software testing concepts (test cases, defects, regression).
* Exposure to manual testing of business or backend systems.
* Basic familiarity with APIs, data validation, or SQL concepts (academic or practical).
* Exposure to enterprise systems, ERP platforms, or data\-driven applications(Oracle ERP/SAP/Microsoft Dynamics).
* Comfortable working with test management or defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, qTest).
* Good at Debugging and root cause analysis
* Willingness to learn complex systems and ask questions.
* Strong attention to detail and reliability in executing assigned work.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Familiarity with REST APIs and JSON payloads.
* Basic scripting or automation exposure (JavaScript, Python, or similar).
* Experience working in Agile teams.
* Interest in growing toward Quality Engineer or Software Engineering roles.



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 




 Enterprise platforms power critical business decisions and operations. As a QA Associate
 **Analyst, you help ensure that features work as expected, data remains accurate, and defects** 




**are caught early.** 




**This role is a foundational entry point into an engineering\-led quality organization—providing hands\-on experience, structured learning, and a clear growth path toward Quality Engineer I and beyond.** 




  





**Benefits \& Perks:** 




 As an Abercrombie \& Fitch Co. (A\&F Co.) associate in our India Global Capability Center (GCC), you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. A\&F Co. is committed to providing competitive and comprehensive benefits that align with our company’s culture and values, but most importantly – with you! We also provide competitive incentives to reward the commitment our associates have for moving our global business forward
 


* Comprehensive group medical insurance covering associate, spouse, children, and parents/in\-laws
* Outpatient medical and wellness allowance for associates and dependents
* Associate assistance program offering confidential counseling for mental, financial, and legal support
* Access to fertility, adoption, and family\-forming benefits through Carrot
* Access to mental health and wellness app, Headspace
* Paid Caregiver leave
* Comprehensive paid leave programs, including earned leave and casual/sick leave
* Paid public and national holidays each year
* Work from anywhere (Mondays and Fridays are “work from anywhere” days for most roles and six work from anywhere weeks per year)
* Seven associate wellness half days per year
* Onsite meal program including daily lunch and pantry snacks/beverages
* Transportation support with point\-to\-point pickup and drop\-off
* Creche/daycare reimbursement support for working parents
* Opportunities for career advancement, we believe in promoting from within
* Global team of people who will celebrate you for being YOU!

title: Quality Testing Associate Analyst
description:
3M has a long\-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World**
 Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a diversity of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.
   

  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**
 As a Quality Testing Associate Analyst, You Will Have The Opportunity To Tap Into Your Curiosity And Collaborate With Some Of The Most Innovative People Around The World. Here, You Will Make An Impact By
   

  

  

* Support QA/Test Management in planning and executing testing across SAP and integrated applications.
* Perform manual, functional, regression, retesting, and UAT support based on requirements, scenarios, and test cases.
* Prepare, review, maintain, and execute test cases while documenting test evidence and results.
* Identify, log, track, retest, and close defects using Jira with proper descriptions, screenshots, severity, and priority.
* Use qTest to manage test cases, track execution, maintain defect status, and support requirements\-to\-test\-case traceability.
* Prepare test status reports and metrics in Excel, coordinate with SAP/business teams, follow QA standards, and escalate risks or blockers on time.


**Your Skills And Expertise**
 To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M is looking for candidates who must have the following qualifications:
   

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
* 0–2 years of experience in Software Testing, QA, SAP Testing, or a related area.
* Basic understanding of SDLC, STLC, manual testing concepts, defect lifecycle, Excel, and clear documentation of test results and defects.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with willingness to learn SAP applications, testing tools, and enterprise testing processes.


**Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:**
* Basic exposure to qTest for test management and Jira for defect logging, tracking, and workflow management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for test tracking, reporting, data analysis, and basic formulas.
* Basic understanding of SAP Testing / Quality \& Test Management and overview of SAP modules such as MM, SD, OTC, and MTD.


**Work Location:** 
 Hebbal, Bangalore (Karnataka), Hybrid Mode
   

  

**Supporting Your Well\-being**
 3M offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, 3M regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.
   

  

 Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M.
   

  

 Safety is a core value at 3M. All employees are expected to contribute to a strong Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) culture by following safety policies, identifying hazards, and engaging in continuous improvement.
   

  

**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1\) uploading a resume, or 2\) entering the information into the application fields directly.**
**3M Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement**
 Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at 3M are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.
   

  

 Please click on the following links and select the country where you are applying for employment to review the applicable Terms of Use (link here) and Privacy Policy (link here). Before submitting your application, you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the terms.

title: Senior Test Analyst Professional
description:
**About the Company** 




 Naviam partners with organizations worldwide to streamline their asset management journey through an unparalleled combination of expertise, innovative solutions, and unwavering commitment.
 



 Born from the unification of seven industry leaders and backed by over three decades of experience, Naviam delivers cutting\-edge enterprise asset management (EAM) solutions and services. Our approach is built on flexibility, collaboration, and partnership—allowing us to provide highly tailored solutions that dynamically evolve with our customers' changing needs.
 



 With our expanded scale and deep industry expertise, we navigate the complexities of modern asset management, introducing new ways of thinking and unlocking innovative technologies that drive impact and lasting value for organizations globally.
 



**Main Purpose:** 




**We are looking for a detail\-oriented Senior QA Tester to join our quality assurance team. In this role, you will collaborate closely with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability. The ideal candidate is passionate about delivering exceptional user experiences, possesses strong analytical skills, and is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.** 




  





**Specific Responsibilities:** 





 \- Perform functional, integration, regression, and acceptance testing for new and existing features.
 





 \- Perform Automation/Performance testing and maintain test run via pipeline
 





 \- Identify, document, and track software defects using a bug tracking system.
 





 \- Verify and validate fixes through retesting, ensuring resolved issues meet quality standards.
 





 \- Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define quality goals and ensure successful software deliveries.
 





 \- Communicate test progress, test results, and other relevant information to stakeholders promptly.
 





 \- Work closely with developers to investigate and resolve identified defects.
 





 \- Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance the quality and efficiency of testing activities.
 





 \- Keep up to date with industry best practices, tools, and technologies to optimize QA processes.
 





 \- Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for test procedures and testing outcomes.
 





 \- Provide clear, concise, and actionable insights to inform product decisions and enhance quality.
 




  





**Skill Requirements \- Essential:** 





 \- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
 





 \- 8\+ years of experience in software quality assurance or software testing.
 





 \- Proficiency in testing methodologies, including functional, regression testing.
 





 \- Maximo knowledge required to help plan and execute numerous projects.
 





 \- Experience with test automation frameworks/tools (e.g., WebdriverIO) or with Performance Testing tool (eg., NeoLoad) is highly desirable.
 





 \- Conduct thorough code reviews and provide meaningful feedback by following established PR review standards and best practices.
 





 \- Basic understanding of programming languages or scripting (e.g., Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML) is a plus.
 





 \- Familiarity with tracking systems (e.g., ADO, Jira, ALM) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
 





 \- Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high\-quality results in a fast\-paced environment.
 





 \- Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
 





 \- Solid communication skills to effectively collaborate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 





 \- Ability to prioritize tasks, handle multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing requirements.
 





 \- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
 





 \- Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on emerging testing trends.
 




  





**Skill Requirements \- Preferable:** 





 \- DevOps Methodology work experience.
 





 \- Demonstrates strong multitasking skills and effectively manages multiple priorities while maintaining the quality of deliverables.
 





 \- Certification in ISTQB/relevant work domain.
 




  





**Person Specification/Attributes:** 




 \- Professional and committed, with a disciplined approach to work.
 



 \- Motivated and driven by finding and providing solutions to problems.
 



 \- Polite, tactful, helpful, empathic nature, able to deliver to the needs of customers.
 



 \- Has respect for others and their views.
 



 \- Technology minded and focused, enthusiastic about technologies.
 



 \- Analytical, able to raise from the detail and see the bigger picture.
 



 \- Dedicated to continually updating and upgrading own knowledge.
 



 \- Carries a mind\-set of continuous improvement, constantly looking for better and more efficient ways of doing things.
 


* \- Values quality at the centre of all things in work.

 The team is actively investing in AI\-assisted software delivery and quality engineering. The successful candidate will be encouraged to leverage AI tools to improve test design, automation development, defect analysis, documentation, and overall delivery efficiency, while maintaining appropriate governance and quality controls.
   

  

 Testing is performed in both manual and automated fashion, but the team focuses on expanding the automated test suites. The projects you will be working on are mainly server\-side.
   

  

**Technology Ecosystem:**
* API Tools: Swagger, Postman, Devtools
* Back End: C\#, SQL Server, WebApi, ReqNRoll/Specflow, Gherkin, Cucumber, FIX
* Architect: Docker Kubernetes, TeamCity, BitBucket, Jira, Confluence, Octopus, Rancher, Influx, KPI Metrics, Nolio

**Primary duties will include:**
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and ensure comprehensive test coverage.
* Own test strategy, estimation, test planning and test execution for new features, enhancements, and production fixes.
* Identify and prioritize test cases for automation, considering both functional and non\-functional requirements and implementing the existing test automation frameworks for backend side of trade system in Specflow/ReqNRoll.
* Test end\-to\-end trading flows across, execution services, FIX gateways, exchange/broker connectivity and downstream processing.
* Analyse server and application logs, system data to isolate defects, support root\-cause analysis and provide clear evidence to Engineering.
* Analyse complex systems, spot trends, draw conclusions, and produce specifications and decisions.
* Perform API, service, database and message\-level testing using appropriate tools and SQL queries.
* Assess release risk, define test exit criteria and provide clear QA recommendations for UAT, production deployment and operational readiness.
* Managing the release deployment in various environments with cooperation with different teams.
* Contribute actively to requirements refinement, Three Amigos discussions, sprint planning, defect triage, demonstrations and retrospectives.
* Document test plans, test cases, and test results to facilitate communication and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Improve QA practices through peer review, reusable test assets, knowledge sharing and measurable reduction of manual regression effort.


**Qualifications**
**To Land this role you will need:**
* Strong professional experience testing complex trading, financial, transactional or other high\-integrity backend systems.
* Hands\-on experience of manual functional, integration, regression and end\-to\-end testing in an Agile delivery environment.
* Confident API and backend\-service testing, with the ability to validate requests, responses, events and persisted data.
* Basic SQL skills for data interrogation, reconciliation and test\-evidence preparation.
* Experience diagnosing issues through application logs, service behaviour, databases and message flows.
* Practical automation experience using C\# or a comparable language to extend the existing test framework.
* Experience with Git\-based version control, CI/CD pipelines and test execution within build and deployment tooling.
* Ability to translate requirements and business workflows into clear, risk\-based test coverage and traceable evidence.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience taking testing from requirements analysis through QA sign\-off, UAT support and production release.


**What will make you stand out:**
* Exchange\-traded derivatives, particularly US Futures.
* Electronic order entry, order management or execution management systems.
* FIX protocol, including session behaviour and execution\-report\-based order lifecycles.
* High\-throughput or low\-latency distributed systems and asynchronous messaging technologies.
* Operational resilience, failover, disaster recovery and controlled production releases.
* Experience with tools or technologies such as Postman, Swagger, SQL Server, Kafka, Kubernetes, Rancher, TeamCity, Jenkins, Octopus, Jira and Confluence.
* Experience evaluating and adopting emerging QA technologies, including AI\-assisted test generation, intelligent test selection, automated defect analysis, synthetic test data generation, and quality analytics.
* Keen interest in understanding the distributed architecture


**Ways of working**
* Builds effective relationships across Product, Business Analysis, Engineering, QA and Operations.
* Challenges requirements constructively and raises delivery or quality risks early with supporting evidence.
* Takes ownership of test outcomes while remaining collaborative and pragmatic.
* Balances detailed functional investigation with automation and continuous improvement.
* Shares domain knowledge and supports peer review to strengthen team resilience.


**Education / Certification Requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* ISTQB or relevant testing certification is advantageous but not essential.


**Working environment:**
* 4 days in office per week

 ●     Establish and manage supplier quality: qualification, Approved Supplier List, risk assessment, performance monitoring, audits, and NCR/CAPA.
 



 ●     Ensure customer/contract quality requirements are identified, reviewed, and flowed into operations; interface with Sales, Engineering, Procurement, and Operations.
 



 ●     Control QMS documentation and records (manual, procedures, inspection/calibration/training/audit records) and maintain a Quality Dashboard (complaints, OTD, NCR/CAPA, audit and calibration status, COPQ) for Top Management reporting.
 



  




**Must\-Have Qualifications \& Experience** 

 ●     B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Aerospace, Production, Electrical, Electronics, or related Engineering discipline.
 



 ●     7\-10 years total experience, including minimum 5 years in Quality/QMS leadership.
 



 ●     Aerospace / Defence / Aviation / high\-reliability engineering background.
 



 ●     Strong working knowledge of AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015; formal Internal Auditor training.
 



 ●     Experience with Certification Body audits, NCR/CAPA systems, root\-cause analysis, and supplier quality.
 



 ●     Comfortable presenting QMS performance to Top Management and driving cross\-functional teams.
 



  




**Preferred / Desirable** 

 ●     Experience with aerospace/defence manufacturing, avionics, precision engineering, MRO, or government/defence customers (HAL, DRDO, IAF, Indian defence ecosystem).
 



 ●     Practical, hands\-on experience implementing or significantly upgrading an AS9100D QMS (not just maintaining an already\-certified system).
 



 ●     Personally led at least one complete AS9100 certification cycle: Gap Assessment → Documentation → Implementation → Internal Audit → Management Review → Stage 1 → Stage 2 → Certification.
 



 ●     Exposure to customer/supplier audits, AS9102 FAI, Configuration Management, Product Safety, and Counterfeit Parts Prevention.
 



 ●     AS9100D / ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, ASQ CQA/CQE, or Six Sigma Green/Black Belt (valuable, not mandatory if hands\-on implementation experience is strong).
 



 ●     PG qualification in Quality Management.
 



  




**Reporting \& Authority** 

 Reports directly to the Managing Director/CEO, with functional authority across Engineering, Procurement, Operations, Inspection, Stores, Projects, Sales/Contracts, and Administration, and unrestricted access to Top Management on QMS and certification matters.
 



  




**Success Criterion** 

 Successful AS9100D certification of the company’s defined scope, followed by a sustainable QMS that passes subsequent surveillance audits and meets customer and aerospace/defence quality requirements.

description:
Non Functional Testing Architect
 



 Location \- Bangalore
 



  





  





 Required Qualifications
 



  





 10\+ years in software QA/testing with at least 5 years focused exclusively on Non\-Functional Testing (performance, load, stress, security) for enterprise\-grade web applications.
 



 Proven track record of architecting and driving NFT programs end\-to\-end — from customer NFR workshops through tooling setup, test execution, and executive\-level reporting.
 



 Hands\-on proficiency with performance/load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or k6, and security testing tools such as OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Nessus, or Qualys.
 



 Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud infrastructure (App Services, Azure Load Testing, Azure Monitor, Application Insights) and its impact on application performance and security posture.
 



 Experience with APM and observability platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, or New Relic) for performance profiling, bottleneck isolation, and capacity planning.
 



 Strong communication and consulting skills — ability to run NFR definition sessions with customers, present risk\-rated findings to non\-technical stakeholders, and align cross\-functional teams on quality gates.
 



 Tech Stack
 



  





 · JMeterLocustGatlingk6OWASP ZAPBurp SuiteNessus / QualysAzure DevOpsAzure Load TestingApplication InsightsDatadogDynatracePlaywrightPythonDocker / Kubernetes
 



  





 Preferred Qualifications
 



  





 Certifications in performance testing (ISTQB Performance Testing Specialist) or security testing (CEH, OSCP, or relevant Azure security certifications).
 



 Experience with UI/UX performance measurement tools (Google Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Core Web Vitals) for page responsiveness and load\-time optimization on B2B portals.
 



 Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment — managing NFT deliverables, customer expectations, and multi\-stakeholder engagements simultaneously.
 



 Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and shift\-left security integration within Azure\-based CI/CD workflows.

 Roles \& Responsibilities

title: Test Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Change the world. Love your job.**
 Test is a crucial time in an IC development process; if you find a bug or an issue, it is a good time to fix it, but every additional second of testing we do, is additional cost when you scale a device into production. So, test engineers must identify the critical points of the device where testing is most necessary and the points where we may want to take some risk. It is a precise balance, that has the potential to save our businesses millions of dollars!
   

  

 Test engineers spend a good amount of time in the lab and when they're not there, they are designing test hardware using software tools like cadence and building test programs on an ATE simulator, or troubleshooting – the programs or the device.
   

  

**Why Multiphase Processor Power (MPP)**
 Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, and data centers are just a few of the trends driving the need for high\-current multiphase switching power in the Enterprise market. The Multiphase Processor Power product line is focused on bringing to market the multiphase controllers and Smart Power Stage (driver plus power FETs with integrated sensing) solutions for enterprise computing and other ASICs that are power hungry and require very high currents (can be 1000A\+). The MPP team actively collaborates with TI’s advanced technology, packaging and research and development teams to deliver the highest power density solutions for the power level.
   

  

**About The Job**
 At TI, Test Engineers leverage strong technical knowledge working hands\-on to bring differentiated power solutions to our customers globally. Test Engineers also partner closely with Design, Test, Systems and Application engineers to ensure our power solutions are both meeting customer and market requirements and are cost\-wise optimized. The MPP product line is working on complex multiphase buck controllers and the world’s breakthrough technology to develop the high\-power density power stages.
   

  

**About The Role And Team**
* Work with the design team to understand design specifications and system challenges
* Generate test plan, create test and char program, design ATE hardware interface boards
* Debug characterizing silicon on ATE, and correlate results with bench data
* Analyze silicon results, supporting failure analysis tasks
* Perform statistical analysis of yield fallout, debug and fix yield issues; optimize test time
* Work with the production team to release products to volume production
* Test strategy definition and implementation for multiphase controller and power stage devices
* Silicon qualification, including the qual program development
* Comprehensive device debugging, design validation, and failure analysis
* Drive for robust and cost\-effective test solutions while being accountable for product quality
* Work with the design and Firmware team to support customer needs, implement custom features in FW. Close collaboration with FW and validation teams to understand the device issues and bugs and find the FW level workaround for the fix.
* Engaging with customers with application engineers, to help them understand the device better, help to fix the issues, and provide modifications if any tweaks are needed. This is done in collaboration with Application engineers.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum requirements:**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
* 5\+ years of relevant experience
* ATE experience on Teradyne Eagle or equivalent analog ATE (iFlex, LTX, VLCT), although Eagle experience is preferred and is a differentiator
* Characterization test program and hardware development experience, Production test program and hardware development experience
* Strong technical knowledge of electronic devices and circuits, and Analog test techniques
* Data analysis skills using Spotfire, dataPower or equivalent tool based on STDF
* Experienced with various lab equipment such as scopes, power supplies, sourcemeters, loads etc.
* Experience with product engineering activities such as yield improvement and test time reduction
* Strong understanding of the IC product development process, from concept to volume production


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Mixed signal test techniques and experience with developing mixed\-signal tests on TI roadmap testers
* Experienced with test program and hardware offload to TI offshore manufacturing sites
* Proficiency in programming/scripting in C\+\+, Python, C\#
* Strong fundamentals in electronics: RC networks, operational amplifiers, ADCs, DACs, DC\-DC buck converters
* Experience to define the test flow, test list and plan to create a test\-architecture strategy.
* Experience in silicon bring\-up and debug, and characterization on the Eagle tester platform
* Expertise in schematic design for Hardware/Device Interface Board (HIB/DIB)
* Experience in writing test plan and designing test cases
* Should be able to lead a project from planning to production release
* Demonstrated strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
* Strong time management skills that enable on\-time project delivery
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, influential relationships
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and rapidly changing environment
* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results


**About Us**

title: PSV: Mid Senior Role
description:
Experienced Post Silicon Validation required to drive Analog and PMIC validation, characterization, and bench\-testing activities. The ideal candidate will have proven experience leading validation teams, developing comprehensive validation strategies, automating bench measurements, and debugging complex silicon issues through close collaboration with Analog Design, System, Product, Applications, and Test Engineering teams.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Working on end\-to\-end post\-silicon validation and characterization of analog IPs and PMIC devices.
* Define validation strategy, test plans, coverage matrices, schedules, and execution milestones.
* Own validation execution across pre\-silicon readiness, first silicon bring\-up, characterization, qualification, and production support.
* Review specifications, design documents, schematics, datasheets, and validation requirements.
* Develop and execute detailed bench\-validation procedures for:
	+ Functional validation
	+ DC and AC electrical characterization
	+ Power, voltage, current, and thermal measurements
	+ Accuracy, efficiency, line/load regulation, and transient response
	+ Protection features such as OVP, UVLO, OCP, OTP, and short\-circuit response
	+ Power sequencing, startup/shutdown, ramp behavior, and fault recovery
	+ Corner, stress, and limit testing
* Build and maintain automated validation frameworks using Python, NI PXI, TestStand, LabVIEW, and related bench\-automation environments.
* Develop reusable test scripts, drivers, measurement utilities, data\-logging modules, and report\-generation solutions.
* Integrate oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, SMUs, source\-measure units, spectrum/network analyzers, and other laboratory equipment.
* Debug silicon, board, firmware, software, and measurement\-related failures using systematic root\-cause\-analysis techniques.
* Analyze characterization data, identify trends and anomalies, and provide technically sound conclusions.
* Own validation reports, defect documentation, failure analysis summaries, and executive\-level status updates.
* Coordinate with global engineering teams and communicate risks, dependencies, silicon issues, and schedule impact.
* Mentor engineers in bench validation, automation, debugging, data analysis, and effective documentation practices.
* Drive continuous improvement in validation coverage, automation efficiency, test quality, and execution processes.











 Required Technical Skills
 



 Analog and PMIC Validation
 


* Strong hands\-on experience in analog IC and PMIC post\-silicon validation.
* Expertise in validating power\-management functions such as:
	+ LDOs
	+ Buck and boost converters
	+ Charge pumps
	+ Battery\-management circuits
	+ Voltage/current references
	+ ADC/DAC interfaces
	+ Power\-path and charging solutions
	+ Protection and monitoring blocks
* Strong knowledge of analog and mixed\-signal measurements, characterization methodologies, and validation flows.
* Experience validating silicon against electrical specifications, datasheet requirements, and design targets.
* Exposure to silicon debug, failure isolation, characterization limits, and engineering change recommendations.

 In this role, you will work closely with engineers, product partners, and senior quality engineers to validate business workflows, data flows, and system behavior across complex, interconnected
